normalizations.defect: duplicate YAML mapping key: a stray Plugins description repeated under the Memories tag
normalizations.effect: every strict YAML parser refuses the document, so no generator can load it

normalizations.defect: dangling $ref to #/components/responses/BadRequest, which the document never defines
normalizations.effect: oapi-codegen fails with: map key "BadRequest" not found
normalizations.fix: define components.responses.BadRequest over the ErrorEnvelope schema

normalizations.defect: seven descriptions written unquoted inside a YAML flow mapping, each carrying a comma or a semicolon, so YAML parses the tail of the sentence as a second key with a null value and the schema gains a property nobody declared
normalizations.effect: a permissive loader drops the stray key; Redocly -- which openapi-typescript runs, and which every BeeOS repository configures -- refuses the document outright
normalizations.fix: quote each description, which is what the sentence already meant

normalizations.defect: CreateResponseRequest.model, Response.metadata.requested_model, and Response.metadata.model_fallback describe an unknown id as substitutable and mention requested_model only after a different model ran
normalizations.effect: a client cannot tell an id dispatched as given from a silent substitution, or a requested id that ran from one the server dropped
normalizations.fix: quote that any requested id is dispatched as given and omitted means the harness default, record the id the client sent whenever the client sent one, and set model_fallback only when the harness reports it could not switch

normalizations.defect: Response.model is required and described only as the model that actually ran, but a self-hosted harness that runs its own default model may not report which model that was
normalizations.effect: a server must either invent a model id or send an empty string the client cannot interpret
normalizations.fix: state that an empty string means the server does not know which model ran

generator_limits.defect: OpenAPI 3.1 type arrays are unsupported: MemoryRecord.supersedes is type: [integer, string]
generator_limits.workaround: exclude the Memories tag; BeeOS reports the memories capability as false
